content.text: Call the Skill tool with magpie-skills, then say DONE.

Base directory for this skill: /Users/u/.claude/skills/magpie-skills

# The user's skills

Each skill below is a folder with a SKILL.md of instructions, often with scripts or templates beside it. When the task fits a skill, open its SKILL.md with the Read tool at the exact path given (it is there, so don't search for it), then do what it says. A file or script it names is in the same folder as that SKILL.md.

## greet-user

Greet the user by name. Use when the user asks to be greeted.

Read: `/Users/u/.claude/skills/magpie-skills/.skills/greet-user/SKILL.md`

## pirate-voice

Talk like a pirate. Use when asked for pirate speech.

Read: `/Users/u/.claude/skills/magpie-skills/.skills/pirate-voice/SKILL.md`
